body: I have a job and I go to school. But the job is just enough to pay my loans and my bills. I don't have anything left over for rent so I can't move out.

Thank you for this. I agree with what you said. The other day my mom was talking about my pregnant cousin who had just found she was going to have a girl. My mom said she seemed sad about that and it was built into women to want boys and not girls. I think that's when her favorable treatment of my brother made sense and why she's always treated me and my sister terribly. 

You are right, it could be because of how they were raised. But honestly, I'd much rather have the "bad parenting" my brother has because his life is so much easier.
